IMMEDIATE

No. 55/4/CF-56
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
CABINET SECRETARIAT
(Department of Cabinet Affairs)
New Delhi, the 31st January 1966.

The undersigned is directed to state that the
designation of Shri A.M. Thomas, Minister of State in the
Ministry of Defence will be as Minister of Defence Production
in the Ministry of Defence.

D. P. Chopra)
for Cabinet Secretary.

To
All Members of the Council of Ministers.

Copy forwarded to the Secretary to the Prime Minister/
the Private Secretary to the Prime Minister, for information.

P.T.O.
